caseName: Dep't of Homeland Sec. v. Regents of the Univ. of Cal.
caseNameFull: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY v. REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA

opinions.text: A total of 80 minutes is allotted for oral argument, and the time is divided as follows: 40 minutes for the Solicitor General, 20 minutes for private respondents, and 20 minutes for state respondent.
